method: Production vite build served by test/e2e/playwright-replay.config.ts, Chromium desktop 1440x900. Time from an in-page click on the step log toggle to the frame after the next paint (double requestAnimationFrame). 320 varied steps (7 tool kinds, thinking, interim text, errors) on a settled turn and on a live turn. The first show is measured once; then 7 hide/show runs. Milliseconds.
cause: Hiding the log unmounted every row except the 3-row ticker, so every show remounted all 320 rows. The profile of a show at 1x: about 57 ms of JS in the Svelte flush (DOM creation, Button rest-props spread, lucide Icon svg), then about 29 ms of style, layout and paint. Collapsed rows render no detail or markdown, so that cost is absent.
fix: TurnActivity keeps the full log mounted once it has been shown and hides it with the hidden attribute (display:none), so showing it again only restyles and lays out the rows.
target: Show again under 160 ms median at 4x CPU throttle. The spec reports timings and asserts them only with STEP_LOG_PERF_ASSERT=1; it always asserts the regression itself, that a hide and show keeps the row elements and a row's open state. Under 100 ms at 4x is not reachable without content-visibility or virtualization; at 1x both before and after are already under 100 ms.

contentVisibilityAuto.note: content-visibility:auto with contain-intrinsic-size:auto 30px on rows. On top of the fix at 4x: show 43 settled / 56 live, first show 232 / 192. Alone at 4x: show 186 / 178. Rejected because src/lib/frontend/style.css records its removal: Safari ignores contain-intrinsic-size:auto and the transcript snaps back while scrolling.

transcriptHistory.note: 40 earlier turns made no difference (show 47 ms vs 49 ms at 1x).
